```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(ggh4x)
library(patchwork)
library(viridis)

file_sources <- list.files(here("scripts"), pattern = "*.R$", full.names = TRUE)
invisible(lapply(file_sources, source))

base_theme <- theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "grey50", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.4),
    axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "grey50"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 7),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(0.8, "lines"),
    panel.spacing.y = unit(0.8, "lines")
  )

square_theme <- theme(aspect.ratio = 1)

guide_clean <- function() {
  guide_colorbar(
    direction = "horizontal", title.position = "top", label.position = "bottom",
    frame.colour = "grey50", ticks = TRUE, ticks.colour = "grey50", frame.linewidth = 0.5
  )
}

add_masks <- function(df) {
  df %>% mutate(
    oxygen_exclusion = as.logical(round(as.numeric(oxygen_exclusion))),
    energetic_exclusion = as.logical(round(as.numeric(energetic_exclusion))),
    energetic_exclusion = if_else(is.na(energetic_exclusion), FALSE, energetic_exclusion),
    excl_o2 = oxygen_exclusion,
    excl_e = !excl_o2 & energetic_exclusion
  )
}

interp_surface <- function(df, x, y, z, facet_cols = character(0), nx = 300, ny = 300) {
  if (length(facet_cols) == 0) {
    dd_valid <- df %>% filter(!excl_o2, !excl_e, is.finite(.data[[z]]), is.finite(.data[[x]]), is.finite(.data[[y]]))
    if (nrow(dd_valid) < 5) return(df)
    ip <- interp_to_grid(dd_valid, xcol = x, ycol = y, zcol = z, nx = nx, ny = ny)
    ip$excl_o2 <- FALSE
    ip$excl_e <- FALSE
    return(ip)
  }

  split_df <- split(df, interaction(df[, facet_cols, drop = FALSE], drop = TRUE))
  purrr::imap_dfr(split_df, function(dd, nm) {
    dd_valid <- dd %>% filter(!excl_o2, !excl_e, is.finite(.data[[z]]), is.finite(.data[[x]]), is.finite(.data[[y]]))
    if (nrow(dd_valid) < 5) return(dd)
    ip <- interp_to_grid(dd_valid, xcol = x, ycol = y, zcol = z, nx = nx, ny = ny)
    for (fc in facet_cols) ip[[fc]] <- dd[[fc]][1]
    ip$excl_o2 <- FALSE
    ip$excl_e <- FALSE
    ip
  })
}



build_mask_surface <- function(mask_df, x, y, nx = 300, ny = 300) {
  md <- mask_df %>%
    mutate(
      excl_e_num = as.numeric(excl_e),
      excl_o2_num = as.numeric(excl_o2)
    )

  e_s <- interp_to_grid(md, xcol = x, ycol = y, zcol = "excl_e_num", nx = nx, ny = ny)
  o_s <- interp_to_grid(md, xcol = x, ycol = y, zcol = "excl_o2_num", nx = nx, ny = ny)

  out <- dplyr::left_join(e_s, o_s, by = c(x, y)) %>%
    mutate(
      excl_e = is.finite(excl_e_num) & excl_e_num >= 0.5,
      excl_o2 = is.finite(excl_o2_num) & excl_o2_num >= 0.5
    )

  out
}
plot_masked <- function(df, x, y, z, palette = c("blue", "viridis", "green", "purple", "red"),
                        fill_title = "", limits = NULL, x_limits = NULL, y_limits = NULL,
                        x_trans = c("identity", "log10"), contour_n = 5, mask_df = NULL,
                        smooth_mask = TRUE, mask_nx = 300, mask_ny = 300) {
  palette <- match.arg(palette)
  x_trans <- match.arg(x_trans)
  if (is.null(mask_df)) mask_df <- df

  mask_plot <- if (isTRUE(smooth_mask)) build_mask_surface(mask_df, x = x, y = y, nx = mask_nx, ny = mask_ny) else mask_df

  val_df <- df %>%
    filter(!excl_o2, !excl_e) %>%
    mutate(.zval = .data[[z]])

  val_na  <- val_df %>% filter(!is.finite(.zval) | is.na(.zval))
  val_neg <- val_df %>% filter(is.finite(.zval) & .zval < 0)
  val_pos <- val_df %>% filter(is.finite(.zval) & .zval >= 0)

  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_raster(data = val_na,  aes(.data[[x]], .data[[y]]), fill = "grey60", interpolate = TRUE) +
    geom_raster(data = val_neg, aes(.data[[x]], .data[[y]]), fill = "grey60", interpolate = TRUE) +
    geom_raster(data = val_pos, aes(.data[[x]], .data[[y]], fill = .zval), interpolate = TRUE)

  if (identical(z, "f") || identical(z, "g")) {
    p <- p + geom_contour(
      data = val_pos, aes(.data[[x]], .data[[y]], z = .zval),
      breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.25,
      colour = "black", alpha = 0.9
    )
  } else if (identical(z, "E_net_norm")) {
    p <- p + geom_contour(
      data = val_pos, aes(.data[[x]], .data[[y]], z = .zval),
      breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.25,
      colour = "black", alpha = 0.9
    )
  } else {
    p <- p + geom_contour(
      data = val_pos, aes(.data[[x]], .data[[y]], z = .zval),
      bins = contour_n, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.25,
      colour = "black", alpha = 0.7
    )
  }

  p <- p +
    geom_raster(data = mask_plot %>% filter(excl_e), aes(.data[[x]], .data[[y]]), fill = "grey70", interpolate = TRUE) +
    geom_raster(data = mask_plot %>% filter(excl_o2), aes(.data[[x]], .data[[y]]), fill = "black", interpolate = TRUE)

  if (palette == "blue") p <- p + scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "#67A5CA", name = fill_title, limits = limits, oob = squish, na.value = "grey60", guide = guide_clean())
  if (palette == "viridis") p <- p + scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "D", name = fill_title, limits = limits, oob = squish, na.value = "grey60", guide = guide_clean())
  if (palette == "green") p <- p + scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "#238b45", name = fill_title, limits = limits, oob = squish, na.value = "grey60", guide = guide_clean())
  if (palette == "purple") p <- p + scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "#6a51a3", name = fill_title, limits = limits, oob = squish, na.value = "grey60", guide = guide_clean())
  if (palette == "red") p <- p + scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "#cb181d", name = fill_title, limits = limits, oob = squish, na.value = "grey60", guide = guide_clean())

  if (x_trans == "log10") {
    p <- p + scale_x_log10(expand = c(0, 0), limits = x_limits, labels = label_scientific())
  } else {
    p <- p + scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = x_limits)
  }

  p +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = y_limits) +
    base_theme + square_theme
}



plot_fg_bivariate <- function(df, x, y, x_limits = NULL, y_limits = NULL, x_trans = c("identity", "log10"),
                              mask_df = NULL, contour_n = 5) {
  x_trans <- match.arg(x_trans)
  if (is.null(mask_df)) mask_df <- df
  if (!all(c("f", "g") %in% names(df))) {
    if (!is.null(mask_df) && all(c("f", "g", x, y) %in% names(mask_df)) && all(c(x, y) %in% names(df))) {
      df <- dplyr::left_join(df, mask_df[, unique(c(x, y, "f", "g")), drop = FALSE], by = c(x, y), suffix = c("", ".m"))
      if (!"f" %in% names(df) && "f.m" %in% names(df)) df$f <- df$`f.m`
      if (!"g" %in% names(df) && "g.m" %in% names(df)) df$g <- df$`g.m`
    }
  }
  if (!all(c("f", "g") %in% names(df))) {
    stop("plot_fg_bivariate() requires both 'f' and 'g' columns in 'df'.")
  }

  dd <- df %>%
    mutate(
      f = if_else(is.finite(f), pmin(pmax(f, 0), 1), NA_real_),
      g = if_else(is.finite(g), pmin(pmax(g, 0), 1), NA_real_),
      fg_eq = f - g,
      prey_lim = 1 - f,
      oxy_lim = 1 - g,
      r_ch = pmin(pmax(1 - (0.86 * prey_lim + 0.58 * oxy_lim), 0), 1),
      g_ch = pmin(pmax(1 - (0.26 * prey_lim + 0.81 * oxy_lim), 0), 1),
      b_ch = pmin(pmax(1 - (0.86 * prey_lim + 0.30 * oxy_lim), 0), 1),
      fg_col = rgb(red = replace_na(r_ch, 1), green = replace_na(g_ch, 1), blue = replace_na(b_ch, 1))
    )

  dd_val <- dd %>% filter(!excl_o2, !excl_e)
  dd_na <- dd_val %>% filter(!is.finite(f) | !is.finite(g))
  dd_ok <- dd_val %>% filter(is.finite(f) & is.finite(g))

  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_raster(data = dd_na, aes(.data[[x]], .data[[y]]), fill = "grey60", interpolate = TRUE) +
    geom_raster(data = dd_ok, aes(.data[[x]], .data[[y]], fill = fg_col), interpolate = TRUE) +
    scale_fill_identity(name = "Limitation mix", guide = "none") +
    geom_contour(data = dd_ok, aes(.data[[x]], .data[[y]], z = f), breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2),
                 colour = "#238b45", linewidth = 0.25, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.9) +
    geom_contour(data = dd_ok, aes(.data[[x]], .data[[y]], z = g), breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2),
                 colour = "#6a51a3", linewidth = 0.25, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.9) +
    geom_contour(data = dd_ok, aes(.data[[x]], .data[[y]], z = fg_eq), breaks = 0,
                 colour = "black", linewidth = 0.35) +
    geom_raster(data = mask_df %>% filter(excl_e), aes(.data[[x]], .data[[y]]), fill = "grey70", interpolate = TRUE) +
    geom_raster(data = mask_df %>% filter(excl_o2), aes(.data[[x]], .data[[y]]), fill = "black", interpolate = TRUE)

  if (x_trans == "log10") {
    p <- p + scale_x_log10(expand = c(0, 0), limits = x_limits, labels = label_scientific())
  } else {
    p <- p + scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = x_limits)
  }

  p + scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = y_limits) + base_theme + square_theme
}


tr <- list(
  a_a = 80, b_R = 0.85,
  a_g = 3, hm = 1,
  f_m = 0.1, b_m = 0.75,
  a_e = 200, b_e = 2 / 3,
  a_c = 60, b_c = 0.75,
  a_sda = 0.2, a_exc = 0.1,
  K = 2.0, h = 2.0,
  T_ref = 10,
  Q10_m = 2.00, Q10_a = 1.20, Q10_o = 1.50, Q10_c = 2.00
)

pO2seq <- seq(0, 30, by = 0.2)
```

## 1) Test diagnostics (single mass/temperature): pO2 vs prey index

```{r test-data}
d_test <- compute_state_surface(tr, masses = 1e4, Tseq = 5, pO2seq = pO2seq,
                                preys = seq(0.01, 0.99, by = 0.01), prey_units = "prey_index",
                                pair_mode = "cross", progress = TRUE) %>%
  add_masks() %>%
  mutate(M_m_norm = M_m/Cmax, M_act_norm = M_act/Cmax, D_SDA_norm = D_SDA/Cmax,
         M_exc_norm = M_exc/Cmax, A_assim_norm = A_assim/Cmax)

diag_interp <- function(z) interp_surface(d_test, "f_ref", "pO2", z, nx = 300, ny = 300)
```

```{r test-plots}

plot_masked(diag_interp("U_opt"), "f_ref", "pO2", "U_opt", "viridis", "U*", x_limits = c(0,1), y_limits = c(0,30), mask_df = d_test) + labs(title="Cruising speed", x="Prey index", y=expression("Oxygen,"~p[O[2]]~" (kPa)"))
plot_masked(diag_interp("f"), "f_ref", "pO2", "f", "green", "f", limits=c(0,1), x_limits = c(0,1), y_limits = c(0,30), mask_df = d_test) + labs(title="Food limitation", x="Prey index", y=expression("Oxygen,"~p[O[2]]~" (kPa)"))
plot_masked(diag_interp("g"), "f_ref", "pO2", "g", "purple", "g", limits=c(0,1), x_limits = c(0,1), y_limits = c(0,30), mask_df = d_test) + labs(title="Oxygen limitation", x="Prey index", y=expression("Oxygen,"~p[O[2]]~" (kPa)"))
plot_masked(diag_interp("M_m_norm"), "f_ref", "pO2", "M_m_norm", "red", "M_M/Cmax", x_limits = c(0,1), y_limits = c(0,30), mask_df = d_test) + labs(title="Basal metabolism", x="Prey index", y=expression("Oxygen,"~p[O[2]]~" (kPa)"))

plot_masked(diag_interp("M_exc_norm"), "f_ref", "pO2", "M_exc_norm", "red", "Excretion/Cmax", x_limits = c(0,1), y_limits = c(0,30), mask_df = d_test) + labs(title="Excretion", x="Prey index", y=expression("Oxygen,"~p[O[2]]~" (kPa)"))
plot_masked(diag_interp("A_assim_norm"), "f_ref", "pO2", "A_assim_norm", "blue", "Assim/Cmax", x_limits = c(0,1), y_limits = c(0,30), mask_df = d_test) + labs(title="Assimilation", x="Prey index", y=expression("Oxygen,"~p[O[2]]~" (kPa)"))
plot_masked(diag_interp("pO2_int"), "f_ref", "pO2", "pO2_int", "purple", expression(p[O[2]]^{int}), x_limits = c(0,1), y_limits = c(0,30), mask_df = d_test) + labs(title="Internal oxygen", x="Prey index", y=expression("Oxygen,"~p[O[2]]~" (kPa)"))
```

## 2) pO2 vs prey density (four separate 4-panel plots)

```{r prey-data}
d_prey <- compute_state_surface(tr, masses=c(1e0,1e4), Tseq=c(5,25), pO2seq=pO2seq,
                                preys=seq(0,5,length.out=220), prey_units="biomass", pair_mode="cross", progress=TRUE) %>%
  add_masks() %>%
  mutate(
    mass_lab=factor(mass, levels=c(1e0,1e4), labels=c("m = 1e0 g","m = 1e4 g")),
    T_lab=factor(T, levels=c(5,25), labels=c("T = 5°C","T = 25°C")),
    M_total_aero = M_m + M_act + D_SDA,
    kO_est = if_else(is.finite(O2_supply) & is.finite(pO2) & is.finite(pO2_int) & (pO2 > pO2_int),
                     O2_supply / (pO2 - pO2_int), NA_real_),
    phi_eff = if_else(is.finite(kO_est) & is.finite(M_total_aero) & M_total_aero > 0,
                      kO_est * pO2 / M_total_aero, NA_real_),
    FAL = if_else(is.finite(M_m) & M_m > 0 & is.finite(M_total_aero),
                  M_total_aero / M_m, NA_real_)
  )

interp_prey <- function(z) d_prey  # keep raw dense grid for stability
```


## 4) Metabolic allocation (stacked; explicit excretion)

```{r metabolic-allocation}
mass_seq <- 10^seq(0, 4, length.out = 120)
scen <- tribble(
  ~scenario, ~T, ~pO2, ~f_ref,
  "Baseline", 5, 25, 0.75,
  "Hyperthermia", 40, 25, 0.75,
  "Hypoxia", 5, 10, 0.75,
  "Oligotrophic", 5, 25, 0.50
)

alloc_long <- purrr::pmap_dfr(scen, function(scenario, T, pO2, f_ref) {
  B_vec <- B_from_f(f_ref = rep(f_ref, length(mass_seq)), m = mass_seq, tr = tr,
                    T_ref = rep(T, length(mass_seq)), pO2_ref = rep(pO2, length(mass_seq)),
                    U_lo = 1e-5, U_mech = 5, enforce_O2_feasible = TRUE)
  purrr::map2_dfr(mass_seq, B_vec, function(m, B) {
    st <- find_U_opt(pO2_env = pO2, T = T, m = m, prey = B, tr = tr, U_lo = 1e-5, U_mech = 5)
    tibble(mass = m, Cmax = st$Cmax,
           M_M = st$M_m, M_A = st$M_act, M_SDA = st$D_SDA, Excretion = st$M_exc, Assimilation = st$A_assim)
  }) %>% mutate(scenario = scenario)
}) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(M_M, M_A, M_SDA, Excretion, Assimilation), names_to = "Process", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(value_norm = value / Cmax,
         Process = factor(Process, levels = c("M_M", "M_A", "M_SDA", "Excretion", "Assimilation")))

alloc_cols <- c(M_M="#bcbddc", M_A="#9e9ac8", M_SDA="#6a51a3", Excretion="#9e9e9e", Assimilation="#2171b5")

ggplot(alloc_long, aes(x = mass, y = value_norm, fill = Process)) +
  geom_area(position = "stack", color = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = label_scientific()) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = alloc_cols) +
  facet_wrap(~scenario, nrow = 1) +
  labs(x = "Mass (g)", y = "Allocation / Cmax", title = "Metabolic allocation") +
  base_theme + square_theme
```
